checks.text: The page shows the heading "Cron Explainer" and the tab labelled "Expression to Text" is active by default.

In the tab labelled "Expression to Text", typing `0 9 * * 1` in the field labelled "Cron expression" shows the text "At 09:00 on Monday" in the element labelled "Description" and the first row of the table labelled "Next occurrences" contains the date "2025-01-06" and the time "09:00".

In the tab labelled "Expression to Text", typing `*/15 8-10 * * *` in the field labelled "Cron expression" shows the text "Every 15 minutes between 08:00 and 10:00" in the element labelled "Description" and the first row of the table labelled "Next occurrences" contains the time "08:00".
In the tab labelled "Expression to Text", clicking the button "Copy description" after entering `0 9 * * 1` shows the toast "Description copied".

In the tab labelled "Text to Expression", selecting "Every day" in the select labelled "Frequency", selecting "09:00" in the field labelled "Time", and clicking the button "Generate" shows `0 9 * * *` in the field labelled "Cron expression".

In the tab labelled "Text to Expression", selecting "Weekly" in the select labelled "Frequency", clicking the checkbox labelled "Monday", selecting "14:30" in the field labelled "Time", and clicking the button "Generate" shows `30 14 * * 1` in the field labelled "Cron expression".

In the tab labelled "Expression to Text", typing `99 99 * * *` in the field labelled "Cron expression" shows the message "Invalid cron expression" in the element labelled "Description" and the table labelled "Next occurrences" is hidden.

In the tab labelled "Expression to Text", typing `0 0 1 1 *` in the field labelled "Cron expression" shows the text "At 00:00 on January 1" in the element labelled "Description" and the first row of the table labelled "Next occurrences" contains the date "2025-01-01" and the time "00:00".
Reload keeps the cron expression "0 9 * * 1" in the field labelled "Cron expression" and the text "At 09:00 on Monday" in the element labelled "Description".
